introduction.title: How to: Setup and connection
introduction.description: This Sales Channel generates a JSONL product feed so your products can appear in ChatGPT search results. To do this, you have to apply as a merchant and share the feed URL with OpenAI. Everything else is explained in the step by step guide below.

open-ai.stepByStep:
• Apply as a merchant at chatgpt.com/merchants
  • Copy the export URL (below) and share it with OpenAI according to the Product feeds docs
  • Make sure the export URL is publicly accessible

introduction.title: How to: Setup and connection
introduction.description: This Sales Channel generates a Google Merchant Center-compatible XML product feed so your products can appear in Google Shopping and AI shopping surfaces. In Merchant Center, add the export URL below as a scheduled file fetch under Settings › Data sources.

google.stepByStep:
• Create a Merchant Center account at merchants.google.com and verify your online store URL
  • In Merchant Center, open Settings › Data sources and click Add product source
  • Choose File, then Add a scheduled fetch from a URL, and paste the export URL (below) as the file URL
  • Make sure the export URL is publicly reachable (no authentication required)
  • Review the Google product data specification and adjust attributes if needed
